name: Multilingual MGSM (CoT)
description: Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) benchmark evaluates language models' chain-of-thought reasoning abilities across ten typologically diverse languages. Contains 250 grade-school math problems manually translated from GSM8K dataset into languages including Bengali and Swahili.
typical_sota_score: ~85–95% English; ~60–85% low-resource languages (frontier models as of 2025)
reputation: Standard multilingual math reasoning benchmark; published at ICLR 2023; reveals large performance gaps between English and low-resource languages; widely used in multilingual LLM evaluations
notes: Published at ICLR 2023. Contains 250 problems per language × 10 languages = 2,500 total problems. Languages: German, French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Swahili, Bengali, Telugu. The CoT variant provides chain-of-thought reasoning steps. Significant performance gaps exist between high-resource (European) and low-resource (Swahili, Bengali, Telugu) languages.
